The same saver instead holds $2,600 in Basic Savings for the whole year. What interest is credited at year end?
In one month the saver makes 9 withdrawals from Basic Savings. What do the withdrawals past the free allowance cost that month?
The saver puts the $2,600 into the 12-month Term Certificate instead. What interest does a full year earn?
The saver instead needs the money in month 7. What interest has the certificate credited for the months actually held?
What is the early-withdrawal penalty, at 90 days of interest?
What interest does the saver actually keep after withdrawing in month 7?
For money that turns out to be needed in month 7, which account left the saver with more interest?
